items.title: 2.8 Elastic and inelastic collisions (elastic aur inelastic takkar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.8 with Figs. 2.10 to 2.14 and Example 2.8 (PDF 41-43, printed 38-40).

blocks.text: Jab tennis ki do balls takrati hain to collision ke baad woh pehle se kam velocity se rebound karti (wapas uchhalti) hain. Is dauran kinetic energy (K.E., motion ki energy) ka kuch hissa lost (zaya) ho jata hai: kuch friction (ragar) se, jab balls dabti (distort hoti) hain aur un ke molecules ek doosre par phisalte hain, aur kuch hissa heat (garmi) aur sound (awaz) energy ban jata hai.
Jis collision (takkar) mein system ki K.E. conserved (qaim, utni ki utni) na rahe, use inelastic collision kehte hain.
Kuch special (khaas) conditions mein collision mein koi kinetic energy lost nahi hoti.
Ideal (bilkul perfect) case mein jab koi K.E. lost na ho, collision perfectly elastic kehlata hai.

Example: hard (sakht) ball marble ke farsh par giraayi jaye to taqreeban usi height tak wapas uchhalti hai; farsh se collision mein bohat hi kam (negligible) energy khoti hai. Yaad rahe: momentum aur total energy har type ke collision mein conserved rehte hain, lekin K.E. sirf elastic collision mein conserved rehti hai.
